name: Motorcycle
description: A motor vehicle with a seat or saddle designed to travel on no more than three wheels. An electric two-wheeler is one only if it isn't a minibike: designed for the road, with wheels of 14 inches or more and a motor rated at 2,238 W (3 horsepower) or more.

restrictions.rule: A seat or saddle and no more than three wheels on the ground (Nebraska Revised Statutes §60-639)

A two-wheeler under 2,238 W or 3 horsepower, with wheels under 14 inches, or designed for off-road use only is a minibike instead; the power floor doesn't apply to a three-wheeler (Nebraska Revised Statutes §60-636, as amended by LB 97 (2025))
No upper limit on motor power or speed (Nebraska Revised Statutes §60-639)
Riders need a Class M license, earned by examination or a motorcycle safety course
A learner's or school permit holder rides only within sight of a licensed motorcycle operator 21 or older

Riders and passengers must wear a helmet meeting FMVSS 218, unless 21 or older and the rider holds a Class M license and has completed the required safety course, or holds another state's motorcycle license
Riders need eye protection (glasses, goggles or a face shield) or a windshield
Titled and registered, with one license plate on the rear
